model_annotation: Figure 6 illustrates training rewards over steps for several models, including LLaMa-1-18B, LLaMa-1-8B, and LLaMa-7B, as well as LLaMa-LUFFY-Easy and LLaMa-On-Policy-Easy, compared against a hard training set. The x-axis is labeled "Steps" and is linear, ranging from 0 to 200, with tick labels incrementing by 50. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards" and scales linearly from 0 to 1, with tick marks at 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1. The LLaMa-7B line is black, solid, and demonstrates a generally decreasing trend, initiating at 0.77 at step 0 and declining to approximately 0.15 at step 200. The LLaMa-1-8B line, also black and solid, begins at a similar level of 0.75 and decreases gradually, reaching roughly 0.13 at step 200. The LLaMa-1-18B line, designated by a black solid line, begins at 0.76 and is seen to decrease to 0.16 by step 200. The LLaMa-LUFFY-Easy line is cyan, solid, with a marker shape of a circle, starting at approximately 0.26 at step 0 and steadily increasing to around 0.87 at step 200. The LLaMa-On-Policy-Easy line is magenta, solid with a marker shape of a triangle, initiating at 0.12 and increasing to roughly 0.75 at step 200.
